integrity: General formulas are proved mathematically; direct finite computations are corroborative, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the positive nilradical rather than the whole modular Witt algebra, counts labeled subspaces and tuples rather than automorphism orbits, and does not determine nonreduced scheme structures. Earlier centralizer formulas are credited. Full text of the closely related 2015 higher-tuple geometry paper and a 2021 paper remains inaccessible; priority is provisional and independent audit has not been performed.
title: Abelian-subalgebra and commuting-tuple spectra of the positive modular Witt nilradical
